notes.title: Completeness strip"'&
notes.text: One cell per column: a stacked bar (good, neutral, gap) and 'known / recorded'. Data: node weights by state bucket. An empty column shows a dotted track, never a full bar."'&

notes.title: Summary tiles"'&
notes.text: Links by state bucket, groups with a gap, and groups that can be improved. The last two are buttons that dim everything else (aria-pressed)."'&

notes.title: View switch"'&
notes.text: Today shows what the current page can record. Complete adds the declared layer. Both views come from one model: visibleIn and stateIn decide what each view shows."'&

notes.title: Canvas"'&
notes.text: Wheel zooms around the cursor, drag pans, double-click fits. The first view fits the width (zoom 0.6 or more); 0 fits everything."'&

notes.title: Canvas controls"'&
notes.text: Select, hand, zoom in and out, fit, 100 percent, zoom to selection and fullscreen. Keys: V H + - 0 1 F and the arrows."'&

notes.title: Inspector"'&
notes.text: Slides in on a click and closes with Esc. The three buttons highlight the groups that feed this one, the groups downstream, and the last column. The red button simulates a failure."'&
